scope: Initial full four-action scorer-label dataset for the selected SmolVLM2 policy

decoder.family: add STOP-only bias then argmax over four first-token action logits

budget_rationale: Sixteen times the debug fitting-root count, at least 128 distinct group-B episodes, four balanced dataset/source strata and a separate 256-root group-C development set. Queues span every allowed scene; root count is fixed before full outcomes. This is an initial experimental scorer dataset, not a data-sufficiency or final-benchmark claim.
runtime_estimate: About 12 hours from the 64-root pilot; varies with STOP frequency, route length and worker imbalance
continuation_source: Actual first candidate followed only by the frozen selected policy; no world-model/scorer/expert continuation
